item.title: 精准操控超冷原子，叶军、Immanuel Bloch共享2026年沃尔夫物理学奖
item.description: 叶军和Bloch虽然具体研究方向有所不同，但二人的工作都建立在对超冷原子系统进行精确操控的基础上，这也是他们共同获得2026年沃尔夫物理学奖的原因。

item.title: Resonant pair production and flat band melting in a driven Rydberg chain
item.description: arXiv:2610.22532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a Rydberg chain subjected to a two-tone periodic drive of the detuning $\Delta(t)$ and Rabi frequency $\Omega(t)$ at frequencies $\omega_1$ and $\omega_2=\nu \omega_1$ respectively with $\nu \in \mathbf{Z}$. In the strong Rydberg blockade limit, such a system reduces to the PXP model and exhibits exact Floquet flat band.
